# Director Console Verification

## Release identity

- Director Console commit: `df2b30c338582fda21d533c2f500bb248133cdb2`.
- Parent: `569f142f45fe72f83e85b22ffda089e429de4e79`.
- The parent had advanced from the prior premium release because of unrelated repository work.
- A direct diff proved that newer remote work changed zero Olam H3 files before this release was cut.
- Push was a normal fast-forward; no force push was used.
- Commit scope: 19 `geelooy/apps/olam-h3/` files only.

## Director Console delivered

- Cinematic Director Console hero with animated viewfinder, focus marks, scanning beam, and compact output/cost rail.
- Live Shot Brief with prompt ingredient coverage for Subject, Action, Camera, Light, Atmosphere, and Audio.
- Coverage labels: Blank canvas, Early direction, Taking shape, and Fully directed.
- Explicit copy clarifies that ingredient coverage is not an artistic quality score.
- Live prompt analysis updates the existing Shot Brief and textarea nodes without rerendering either one.
- Four editable style lanes: Neo-noir, Golden hour, Documentary, and Dreamlike macro.
- Style fragments append only once and remain ordinary editable prompt text.
- Four practical reference recipes: character consistency, motion/camera transfer, frame transition, and voice/ambience.
- Recipe cards switch to the correct H3 control mode.
- Existing premium glass, provider onboarding, prompt templates, reference guidance, submission geometry, and security behavior remain intact.

## Automated verification

- Every Olam file remains at or below 120 lines.
- JavaScript and test syntax checks passed.
- Clean release-tree unit suite: **23 tests passed, 0 failed**.
- New domain tests prove blank, partial, and fully directed ingredient coverage plus idempotent style-lane appending.
- A fully directed prompt reaches 100% with all six ingredients present.

## Local browser verification

Two fresh Chrome profiles were run against the same current-code server at phone geometry.

Director-specific browser proof passed:

- one Director hero rendered
- four reference recipes rendered
- viewfinder animation was active
- initial coverage was 0%
- a full prompt updated coverage to 100%
- all six ingredient chips became present
- textarea identity stayed unchanged
- Shot Brief identity stayed unchanged
- textarea focus stayed active
- Golden-hour style lane appended editable direction
- frame-transition recipe switched to Frames mode
- no horizontal overflow
- zero captured console errors and failed HTTP responses

The complete previously shipped premium/mobile/security smoke also passed unchanged in a separate fresh Chrome profile.

## Production deployment

Canonical deployment fast-forwarded production to `df2b30c338582fda21d533c2f500bb248133cdb2` and emitted:

- `CANONICAL_SERVER_ACTIVE sha=df2b30c338582fda21d533c2f500bb248133cdb2`
- `CANONICAL_DEPLOY_OK sha=df2b30c338582fda21d533c2f500bb248133cdb2`

Public requests for `PromptIngredients.js`, `DirectorStyles.js`, and `director-brief.css` succeeded before browser verification.

## Public browser verification

A fresh production Director Chrome profile and a separate fresh premium-regression Chrome profile both completed under one guarded job with exit code `0`.

The Director production assertions were identical to the local Director proof: live 0% to 100% coverage, all six ingredients, preserved DOM identity/focus, style-lane append, recipe-driven Frames mode, active viewfinder animation, no overflow, and zero captured browser/network errors.

The complete premium/mobile/security smoke then passed against `https://awtsmoos.com` in its own profile, proving the Director Console did not regress the prior UI, MiniMax onboarding, provider guard, or no-overlap behavior.

## External boundary

Production still requires an authorized `MINIMAX_API_KEY` before a real paid H3 request can be sent. No safe repository action can invent or recover that third-party secret.
